items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: we would have dreams about getting a call to play with Buddy Rich or Stan Kenton.

ctx.x: Well yeah. Thanks. I can see that I’m a lucky man. I’m a lucky man because not everybody comes to the United States and fulfills their dreams. Speaking about music you know a lot of musicians from different countries come to the United States with an idea, with a dream and not everybody has been able to see their dreams come true. I’m one of the luckiest ones that I have seen my dreams come true.
When I was in college a certain group of us, we would have dreams about getting a call to play with Buddy Rich or Stan Kenton. You know I dreamt about being a member of Blood, Sweat & Tears.
